title: Alberta data center could release heat equivalent to 23 atomic bombs a day
teaser: A proposed data center in Alberta could release 16 to 18 gigawatts of heat per day, according to a preliminary analysis commissioned by the Sturgeon Lake Cree Nation. That is roughly the heat output of two dozen atomic bombs, concentrated at a single site. The provincial government declined to require a full environmental assessment for Wonder Valley, leaving the project’s overall impact to be addressed through permits for air, land and water.
